member.name: Index
member.para: The verification. On the project's two-GPU test box (GeForce GTX 1070 + Intel UHD 630), 2026-07-28, from both ends: by GPU load and memory monitoring in the desktop session, and over SSH by watching the GTX's VRAM go from its 1225 MiB idle baseline to 3208 MiB at 100% utilization for index 1 while index 0 left it untouched - and ran 8.6x slower, 130.1 s against 15.1 s.
